checks.command:
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, sys, yaml
home = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("HERMES_HOME", pathlib.Path.home() / ".hermes")).expanduser()
config_path = home / "config.yaml"
try:
    config = yaml.safe_load(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
except FileNotFoundError:
    sys.exit(f"FAIL: Hermes config missing: {config_path}")
except Exception as exc:
    sys.exit(f"FAIL: cannot read Hermes config {config_path}: {exc}")
enabled = config.get("plugins", {}).get("enabled", [])
disabled = config.get("plugins", {}).get("disabled", [])
plugin = "thesystem-memory-write-labels"
if not isinstance(enabled, list) or plugin not in enabled or (isinstance(disabled, list) and plugin in disabled):
    sys.exit(f"FAIL: {plugin} is not enabled in {config_path}")
import importlib.util, sys, tempfile
plugin_dir = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("THESYSTEM_CLONE", pathlib.Path.cwd())) / "agents/.harness/plugins/thesystem-memory-write-labels"
old_home = os.environ.get("HERMES_HOME")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="monitor-memory-labels-") as temporary_home:
    os.environ["HERMES_HOME"] = temporary_home
    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("monitor_memory_write_labels", plugin_dir / "__init__.py",
                                                  submodule_search_locations=[str(plugin_dir)])
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        sys.exit("FAIL: cannot load memory labels plugin module")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    try:
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        handler = module._pre_tool_call
        cases = [
            ("valid", {"tool_name":"memory", "args":{"action":"add", "target":"user", "content":"[user-fact] monitor sample"}}, "modify"),
            ("wrong-target", {"tool_name":"memory", "args":{"action":"add", "target":"memory", "content":"[user-fact] monitor sample"}}, "block"),
            ("unlabeled", {"tool_name":"memory", "args":{"action":"add", "target":"memory", "content":"monitor sample"}}, "block"),
            ("too-long", {"tool_name":"memory", "args":{"action":"add", "target":"user", "content":"[user-fact] " + "x" * 301}}, "block"),
        ]
        for name, arguments, expected in cases:
            result = handler(**arguments)
            if not isinstance(result, dict) or result.get("action") != expected:
                sys.exit(f"FAIL: golden sample {name}: expected {expected}, got {result!r}")
        print("OK: valid write modified; wrong target, missing label, and >300-character content blocked (scratch home only)")
    finally:
        sys.modules.pop(spec.name, None)
        if old_home is None:
            os.environ.pop("HERMES_HOME", None)
        else:
            os.environ["HERMES_HOME"] = old_home

checks.threshold: No procedure waits longer than 1 hour.
Alert above 150 runs per instance per day.

safe_state.switch: hold memory-write routing and queue state unchanged
safe_state.description: Do not disable the plugin, reroute writes, modify pending requests, or execute any sample write automatically; the approved golden sample is explicitly dry-run only.

sampling.what: Daily sample of 10 randomly selected memory writes, assessing label correctness, skill-edit quality, and recovery after refusal; use only privacy-safe review evidence and do not expose memory contents in alerts.
sampling.working_well: Each sampled item is routed to the approved destination with correct labeling, any skill edit is sound, and the agent recovers correctly after refusal; each golden sample case is evaluated without saving a write.
